text:
carmen: Heads-up — users reporting stuttering when scrubbing large time ranges on dashboards in eu-canary after yesterday's routing tweak. Hitches ~200-700ms. :confused:
devin: Seen it too. Flamegraph: main thread pinned in `deserializeMetrics` and `renderCanvas`. Link: https://perf.redwood/fg/1743210000
lee: two recent diffs line up: 1) routing changed to `prefetch.affinity = tenant_strict` 2) quota bucket size reduced from 300 -> 120 to conserve memory in canary. That combination increases repeated prefetches and kvcache churn.
maria: also the latest client build merged `fast-base64` into main to avoid worker roundtrips. So decode and deserialization happen on main now.
(quoted config)
```
# changeset 2026-04-02
routing:
  prefetch:
    affinity: tenant_strict
quota:
  bucket:
    size: 120  # was 300
bundle:
  splitpoints:
    fast_base64: merged_into_main
```

ops-bot: "canary deploy detected: routing.prefetch.affinity=tenant_strict, quota.bucket.size=120, splitpoint fast_base64 merged"
carmen: quick triage notes: - prefetch fanout per-tenant increased envelope counts per session - smaller buckets caused more kvcache evictions -> more fetches -> more deserializations - main chunk decode cost visible on flamegraph
devin: quick mitigation: - flip a canary flag to defer deserialize to worker (`telemetry.defer_deserialize=true`) - temporarily restore quota.bucket.size=300 in canary - revert prefetch.affinity to `tenant_relaxed` for 12h
lee: I can flip the flag and revert quota now. ops-bot: "feature toggle telemetry.defer_deserialize=true for eu-canary at 1743210032" ops-bot: "quota.bucket.size set to 300 in eu-canary at 1743210035"
maria: after toggles, interactive hitches drop to ~40-110ms. Good signal. We should still address long-term: 1) split `fast_base64` into worker-shared chunk 2) add perf gate on main_chunk parse_time + bundle-delta fail if > +75KB gz 3) add router-side dedupe to avoid identical prefetches across tenant routes 4) instrument kvcache-eviction -> telemetry-envelope rate in console dashboards
carmen: agreed. I'll open tickets and tag owners. Also propose adding a canary rollback UX: if main-thread deserialize_ms > 150ms sustained for 60s, auto-pause telemetry sampling in that region.
devin: adding ENG-PLAT-950 (worker-shared fast_base64), ENG-PLAT-951 (prefetch dedupe), ENG-PLAT-952 (perf-gate bundle-delta), ENG-PLAT-953 (canary decode guard).
lee: we should also add microbench to CI for deserialize throughput so future routing/quotas changes include parse impact.
maria: created a quick PR `eng-platform/telemetry-deserialize-bench` that runs on CI nightly.
carmen: thanks all — leaving `telemetry.defer_deserialize=true` on for eu-canary while tickets progress. We'll reconvene if we see regression. :rocket:
